findings.reason: The printed p. 726 glyph specimens’ individual identities remain unresolved, but this article does not cite the 字源 scan as support for any claim or use its specimens. Its graphic account is supported independently by the Zhengzhou study and Shuowen evidence; the north-loan and Qin–Han writing claims cite separate study records. The unresolved specimen identities are therefore immaterial to the claims in this article.
